cases.name: Summarizes an encyclopedia article
must_include: a title line with the page title
a 3–5 sentence summary in plain language
5–10 key items in bullets, most important first, with key terms in bold
must_not_include: facts that aren't on the page, unless labeled as background

cases.name: Reviews a documentation page
cases.input: Review this page and tell me the key items: https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/venv.html
must_include: what a virtual environment is and why to use one
the command to create one
how to activate it

cases.name: Page that can't be read
must_include: says it couldn't read the page
asks the user to paste the text
must_not_include: a summary guessed from the URL or title
cases.notes: The domain doesn't exist, so the page can never load.

cases.name: Out-of-scope request
cases.input: Write me a poem about autumn.
must_include: politely says it focuses on summarizing pages
suggests asking Claude directly

cases.name: Summarizes pasted text and keeps numbers exact
cases.input: Summarize this: Our office moves to 42 Harbor Street on March 3, 2027. Parking passes cost $35/month and must be requested by February 10. Badges stop working at the old office on March 1.
must_include: 42 Harbor Street
March 3, 2027
$35/month
February 10
March 1
must_not_include: changed or rounded dates or amounts

cases.name: Stays short
must_include: the whole review is under about 300 words
sections in this order: title line, Summary, Key items

cases.name: Your own example: meeting announcement
cases.input: Summarize this: The quarterly all-hands is moved from Friday to Thursday, Nov 12 at 3pm in Room B. Remote staff should use the usual video link. Please submit questions for the Q&A by Tuesday.
cases.expected_output:
**📄 All-hands update**

**Summary**
The quarterly all-hands moves to Thursday, Nov 12 at 3pm in Room B, with the usual video link for remote staff. Questions for the Q&A are due Tuesday.

**Key items**
- **New date:** Thursday, Nov 12 at 3pm (was Friday)
- **Where:** Room B; remote staff use the usual video link
- **Action:** submit Q&A questions by **Tuesday**
must_include: the new day, date and time
Room B
the Tuesday deadline for questions
cases.notes: Example of a user-provided test: input plus the answer they want. Graded on meaning, not exact wording.
